newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures recover on buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures recover on buying.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery recovered marginally by 3.5 rupees to 1,115.50 rupees per quintal on stray buying, traders said.
Castorseed June delivery lost 28 rupees per quintal in the last two trading sessions under selling pressure, triggered by heavy arrivals.
"The pressure of arrivals has come down to some extent," said a trader.
In edible oils, groundnut oil was steady at 368/369 rupees per 10 kg. In Rajkot, it improved marginally by 2.0 rupees to 570 rupees per 15 kg.
Imported palm oil was steady at 295 rupees per 10 kg.
